title.zh: Trezor warns CryptoBilis buyers to move funds over suspected implant
title.en: Trezor warns CryptoBilis buyers to move funds over suspected implant

current_state.zh: Trezor warned customers who bought Safe 5 devices from former reseller CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a reported unauthorized circuit board capable of capturing screen data and recovery phrases was found in one device.
